overview.summary: Add a complete English-language Reiki section at /en/ — independent audience from the Ukrainian coaching site (/). Dark midnight theme (Cormorant Garamond + Inter), gold+sage palette, Three.js Reiki symbols animation, 54 journal articles as Astro content collection, 6 geo landing pages, booking form → existing Supabase backend with source:'reiki-en'.
constraints: NO language switcher in nav — only hreflang in <head>
Static SSG (output: 'static') — same as existing site
Zero impact on existing Ukrainian pages
Three.js for Reiki symbols section — bundled as React island or inline script

src/layouts/.ReikiLayout.astro: Dark-theme base layout for all /en/ pages. lang='en', midnight bg, Cormorant Garamond + Inter fonts, reiki-specific OG/meta, hreflang tags, JSON-LD (LocalBusiness schema for Reiki practitioner)

src/components/reiki/.ReikiHeader.astro: Fixed dark header with brand 'Viktoria Zhulova', nav links (About/Results/Reiki/Packages/FAQ/Journal), Book CTA button, hamburger menu
src/components/reiki/.ReikiMobileMenu.tsx: React island (client:media max-width:1024px) — fullscreen dark mobile nav overlay
src/components/reiki/.ReikiFooter.astro: Dark footer with copyright, email, Instagram placeholder, privacy link, hreflang link to UA version, medical disclaimer
src/components/reiki/.HeroSection.astro: Full-viewport hero with eyebrow, name, role, offer text, dual CTA (Book + See packages), photo placeholder + stats grid, ambient gold gradient
src/components/reiki/.CitiesMarquee.astro: Infinite CSS-animated marquee of Riviera cities with gold dots
src/components/reiki/.RecognitionSection.astro: Pain-points grid (4 items) with numbered cards, gold left-border hover
src/components/reiki/.OutcomesSection.astro: 6-column outcomes grid with hover gold top-line, medical disclaimer
src/components/reiki/.AboutSection.astro: 2-col grid: photo placeholder + bio text + credentials grid (Training/Background/Languages/Location)
src/components/reiki/.ReikiSymbolsSection.tsx: React island (client:visible) — Three.js particle animation cycling through Cho Ku Rei / Sei He Ki / Hon Sha Ze Sho Nen. Kanji block + explanatory text overlay. Uses custom WebGL shaders for morphing particles.
src/components/reiki/.SessionFlowSection.astro: 4-step flow grid (WhatsApp chat → 45min session → closing → location options)
src/components/reiki/.PackagesSection.astro: Two groups: 'If you're visiting' (2 packages) + 'If you live here' (3 packages). Featured card styling. Package buttons scroll to booking form and pre-select dropdown.
src/components/reiki/.TestimonialsSection.astro: 2-col testimonials grid with star ratings, serif italic quotes
src/components/reiki/.FaqSection.astro: Accordion FAQ with <details>/<summary>, gold + icon rotation
src/components/reiki/.BookingSection.astro: 2-col: form (phone/request/email/package select + consent) + side text. Form is static HTML, submission handled by BookingForm React island.
src/components/reiki/.BookingForm.tsx: React island (client:idle) — handles form submission to /api/submit-lead with source:'reiki-en', shows success state, WhatsApp fallback link
src/components/reiki/.JournalPreview.astro: Grid of 6 latest journal cards with tag/title/excerpt/read-time/arrow
src/components/reiki/.ScrollAnimations.ts: Intersection Observer for .fade-up elements (same pattern as existing site)

src/pages/en/.index.astro: Main Reiki landing page — assembles all sections from components/reiki/
src/pages/en/.privacy-policy.astro: English privacy policy page using ReikiLayout

journal/.index.astro: Journal listing page — all published articles, filterable by tag
journal/.[...slug].astro: Dynamic article pages from reiki-journal content collection

src/pages/en/.[city].astro: Dynamic geo pages for 6 cities — generated from static paths array

reiki-journal/._description: 54 markdown files generated from articles.json, each with frontmatter (title, meta_title, meta_description, keyword, tag, cta, read, publishDate, published) and markdown body

src/data/.reikiContent.ts: Static content data: hero text, pain points, outcomes, about bio, session flow steps, packages (names/prices/descriptions), testimonials, FAQ items, cities list for marquee
src/data/.reikiGeoPages.ts: Geo page data for 6 cities: slug, title, meta, hero overrides, local content

src/styles/.reiki.css: Reiki-specific CSS custom properties (--midnight, --deep, --surface, --gold, --sage, --text vars) and component styles that can't be expressed in Tailwind. Imported only in ReikiLayout.astro — zero impact on UA pages.

public/images/reiki/._description: Hero portrait, about portrait, OG image for /en/. WebP format, optimized with Sharp.

tests/e2e/.reiki-en.spec.ts: Playwright E2E: page loads, all sections render, form submission, mobile menu, scroll animations, Three.js canvas present
tests/e2e/.reiki-visual.spec.ts: Playwright visual regression: screenshots compared against prototype baseline for hero, packages, journal sections
tests/e2e/.reiki-geo.spec.ts: E2E for all 6 geo city pages
tests/e2e/.reiki-journal.spec.ts: E2E for journal listing + individual article pages

dynamicPages.description: 54 individual article pages from reiki-journal content collection

apiEndpoints.change: Existing endpoint — reiki form sends { source: 'reiki-en', phone, email, request, package } — no backend changes needed, just different payload shape

hreflang.strategy: Inject in ReikiLayout <head>: <link rel='alternate' hreflang='en' href='https://zhulova.com/en/' /> and <link rel='alternate' hreflang='uk' href='https://zhulova.com/' /> on both layouts. BaseLayout.astro gets the reciprocal tag.

sitemap.note: @astrojs/sitemap will auto-discover all /en/ pages. No config changes needed — it crawls all generated pages.

componentList.name: ReikiLayout
componentList.description: Base layout for all EN pages

componentList.name: ReikiSymbolsSection
componentList.description: Three.js particle animation — WebGL shaders, 300 particles morphing between 3 Reiki symbols

componentList.name: BookingForm
componentList.description: Form logic: validation, submit to /api/submit-lead, success state, WhatsApp link

tailwindThemeExtension.description: Extend existing tailwind.config.mjs with reiki dark theme colors. These are additive — no existing tokens change.
tailwindThemeExtension.note: Reiki pages use CSS custom properties (var(--midnight) etc.) in src/styles/reiki.css for the prototype-matched values. Tailwind tokens are a convenience layer for components that prefer utility classes. Both approaches coexist.

tag.description: Content category tag — one of: Arrival, Body, Burnout, Distance, Expats, Family, Founders, Inner life, Local, Nervous system, Practice, Trust, Visiting

cta.description: Which CTA/package to highlight at article end

publishDate.description: Publish date for scheduled publishing. Launch batch (first 8 articles) get launch date. Remaining 46 articles get sequential dates, 1/day after launch.

published.description: Filter unpublished articles at build time

generation.description: Node script that reads /Users/george_pc2/Desktop/reiki-riviera-journal/articles.json and generates 54 .md files in src/content/reiki-journal/. Each file: YAML frontmatter (mapped fields + computed publishDate) + markdown body. Launch batch: articles 0-7 get publishDate = LAUNCH_DATE. Articles 8-53 get publishDate = LAUNCH_DATE + (index - 7) days.

configUpdate.change: Add reikiJournalCollection alongside existing coursesCollection, export in collections object

geoPages.strategy: Single [city].astro template with getStaticPaths() returning 6 entries. Each entry carries city-specific props (title, meta, hero text, local details) from src/data/reikiGeoPages.ts.
geoPages.design: Same dark midnight theme as main /en/ page but with city-specific LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, adapted hero headline, and city-relevant FAQs

threeJsIntegration.approach: React island component (ReikiSymbolsSection.tsx) with client:visible directive. Three.js imported as npm dependency (add 'three' to package.json). Symbol point data stored in a separate .ts file for code-splitting.

details.animation: Continuous cycle: scatter → morph to symbol → hold → scatter → next symbol. ~10.4s per cycle, 31.2s total loop.
details.shaders: Custom vertex/fragment shaders for particle morphing with turbulence, twinkling, and gold/sage color mixing
details.performance: requestAnimationFrame loop, frustumCulled=false, maxPixelRatio=2, resize handler

payload.name: optional (not in reiki form)
payload.package: selected package name or 'Not sure yet'

formIntegration.validation: Zod schema in BookingForm.tsx — phone required, email format, consent checkbox

jsonLd.mainPage: LocalBusiness + Person schema — Reiki practitioner in Cannes
jsonLd.articles: Article schema with author, datePublished, keywords

seoStrategy.robots: All /en/ pages indexable. Sitemap auto-generated by @astrojs/sitemap.
seoStrategy.ogImages: Custom OG image for /en/ (dark theme branded). Article pages use shared OG or article-specific.

tests: BookingForm.tsx — form validation, submit success/error, source:'reiki-en' in payload
ReikiSymbolsSection.tsx — renders canvas, Three.js initialization (mock WebGL context)

performance.bundleSize: Three.js adds ~150KB (gzipped ~50KB) — only loaded on /en/ pages via client:visible (code-split). Monitor total JS stays under 100KB limit for pages without Three.js.

implementationOrder: 1. Create feature/reiki-en branch from master
2. Extend tailwind.config.mjs with reiki color tokens
3. Create src/styles/reiki.css with CSS custom properties
4. Create ReikiLayout.astro (dark theme base layout)
5. Create ReikiHeader.astro + ReikiMobileMenu.tsx + ReikiFooter.astro
6. Create src/data/reikiContent.ts with all static content from prototype
7. Build all section components (Hero → Cities → Recognition → Outcomes → About → Flow → Quote → Packages → Testimonials → FAQ → Booking → Journal preview)
8. Create ReikiSymbolsSection.tsx with Three.js (install three package)
9. Create BookingForm.tsx (form submission to /api/submit-lead)
10. Assemble src/pages/en/index.astro
11. Run generate-reiki-journal.ts script to create 54 .md files from articles.json
12. Update src/content/config.ts with reiki-journal collection
13. Create journal pages: src/pages/en/journal/index.astro + [...slug].astro
14. Create geo pages: src/pages/en/[city].astro + src/data/reikiGeoPages.ts
15. Create src/pages/en/privacy-policy.astro
16. Add hreflang tags to both BaseLayout.astro and ReikiLayout.astro
17. Write E2E tests (reiki-en.spec.ts, reiki-visual.spec.ts, reiki-geo.spec.ts, reiki-journal.spec.ts)
18. Write unit tests for React islands
19. Run full build (astro check && astro build) — verify zero type errors
20. Run Playwright tests — verify all pass
21. Run Lighthouse on /en/ — verify 90+ performance
